headline: Tong Hui Kang climbs to 20th, just outside ARC-3 gold

sections.text: Tong Hui Kang gained 3.93 to reach 37.92, moving from 67th to 20th on the ARC-3 board.
The last of 19 gold places is at 37.98, leaving him 0.06 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
